analysis.r1_decision_rationale: NO_CHANGE. The support evidence admits no better pipeline: the R0 pipeline is bit-exact on 5/5 pairs and every single-axis perturbation collapses to 19.9-29.9 dB. The R0 checkpoint's support PSNR 29.91 (<35) is therefore a training-capacity / information-loss ceiling (gamma sev5 clips 8.5-55.6% of pixels; clipped content is unrecoverable), not an identification error. Changing the pipeline would contradict the only exact evidence available; no forced training (training_strategy_R1.json not produced).
